metadata.title: Umbilic slopes and cubic Weingarten surfaces
metadata.abstract: We study umbilic slopes and the global classification of cubic Weingarten surfaces. For a smooth surface in Euclidean three-space, a nonconstant principal curvature germ with a unique secant tangent has slope zero, minus one, infinity, an odd integer at least three, or its reciprocal. At a nonconstant umbilic germ, a smooth regular relation between mean and Gaussian curvature supplies such a tangent after a continuous labeling of the principal curvatures; the ordered curvature image has at most two limiting directions, both in the same set. We also classify compact immersed surfaces without boundary of class $C^4$ satisfying $\kappa_2=c\kappa_1^3$ in some order at every point, for a fixed real $c$: each connected component is embedded as an ellipsoid of revolution. The arguments share a classification of homogeneous Hessian identities at an umbilic. Scalar unique continuation treats infinite-order contact in the smooth slope problem, whereas an exact fourth-order growth estimate and angular energy estimates yield the cubic classification.

analysis.workSummary: 限制脐点附近主曲率像的可能切线斜率，并将满足固定三次 Weingarten 关系的闭 C⁴ 浸入曲面分类为旋转椭球。
techniques: 脐点齐次 Hessian 恒等式
四阶增长与角向能量估计
analysis.breakthrough: 将局部脐点退化约束连接到闭曲面的全局分类。
analysis.limitations: 斜率结论需要非恒定曲率芽及切线条件；分类需要闭曲面、正则性和固定参数，不适用于任意 Weingarten 关系。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露主要借助 ChatGPT，并称数学内容经作者核验和完成；声明未细分每项工具对具体引理的贡献。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.19188v1 · PDF第24页，Disclosure on AI assistance

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露主要借助 ChatGPT，并称数学内容经作者核验和完成；声明未细分每项工具对具体引理的贡献。

analysis.priorityReason: 曲率关系及刚性是主方向，局部到整体的论证具有方法价值。
